content: Hi! Let me know if you need an update on your recent payments or have any questions about processing times.
Hey, I just sent my half of the rent, $842.50, using Venmo to the landlord's account. Can you check if it went through on your end?

Absolutely! I see a Venmo payment of $842.50 from your username (@emmalin92) to Mr. Patel's account (@lakeviewApts) at 4:13 PM today. The transaction ID is #1974553. It should reflect in Mr. Patel's statement within one business day, but Venmo usually processes these instantly.
Great, thanks. I used the note 'May Rent - Apt 227B' just in case.
Perfect, adding 'May Rent - Apt 227B' ensures it's matched to our apartment. Mr. Patel requested all tenants include apartment numbers to speed up his records, so that'll help avoid any delays.
He still has my old phone number on file. Should I text him from my new number ending in 7642 to confirm?

That's a good idea, he might recognize your new number (7642) more quickly. If you text him the transaction ID #1974553 and your full name, Emma Lin, he'll be able to confirm receipt without confusion.
Okay, will do. Is there anything else I need to send him, or does he have all the details now?

He has everything: your payment from @emmalin92, the note with Apt 227B, and soon your text from the updated number. If he needs anything else, he'll reach out to the email he has for you, emma.lin.rentals@gmail.com. Let me know if the payment doesn't clear by tomorrow morning.
